# ECN-2026-026 - Change notice - Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-SB03

Reason for change
- Replace the current lubricant specification for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03) to standardize maintenance stock and reduce cross-contamination risk. The approved lubricant part number for EQ-P3-L4-SB03 is CFW-LUB-526. This change aligns PM execution with supply chain stocking and with procedures cited below.

Affected items
- Maintenance tasks and material lists for EQ-P3-L4-SB03 within the Preventive Maintenance master record.  
- Parts lists and reagent inventories that reference lubricants for shot blast cabinet maintenance.  
- Work instructions and operator checklists that call out lubricant selection for cabinet components.

Implementation
- Update the Preventive Maintenance task card for EQ-P3-L4-SB03 to specify CFW-LUB-526 as the required lubricant. Reference and modify SOP-P3-L4-03 and SOP-P3-L4-05 where lubricant selection is listed.  
- Revise the inventory master to include CFW-LUB-526 as the stocked item for P3, line P3-L4 maintenance kits associated with EQ-P3-L4-SB03.  
- Communicate the change to maintenance technicians and operators via the maintenance bulletin and include a brief hands-on review during the next scheduled toolbox meeting. Use MM-P3-L4-SB03 to coordinate material movement and disposal of any superseded lubricant stock.  
- Secure a single point of accountability for issuance of CFW-LUB-526 and document transfers through the existing material movement record referenced in MM-P3-L4-SB03.

Approvals
- Maintenance Manager: approval required to release revised PM task card.  
- Operations Supervisor: approval required to update operator checklists and authorize bulletin distribution.  
- Materials Specialist: approval required to update inventory records and place reorder actions for CFW-LUB-526.

Related documents
- MM-P3-L4-SB03  
- SOP-P3-L4-03  
- SOP-P3-L4-05
